description: Upgrading of Main Road 220 between Palmers Lane and Wilderness Road : review of environmental factors is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. Environmental Resources Management (ERM) was commissioned by the Roads and Traffic Authority (RTA) to prepare a review of environmental factors (REF) for the upgrading and realignment of Main Road 220 between Palmers Lane and Wilderness Lane near Rothbury (Figure 1.1). This section of road is a single carriageway with substandard alignment and poor pavement condition. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Roads and Traffic Authority of New South Wales. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
